fixed.explanation: _retryAction waits between retries with a page-side setTimeout via evaluateInUtility, which never fires when JS is disabled. Replace with a server-side timer raced via progress.race, so the wait is done on the Playwright side.

input.intent: Injected script's retry loop between action retries (e.g. click retries) waits using a page-side setTimeout inside the utility world; with JS disabled timers never fire. Should instead wait on the Playwright side (server) between retries, e.g. in the retry/poll logic of the frame's element action handling.
input.symptom: With JavaScript disabled in the context, retried actions hang because the page-side timer used for the wait between retries never fires.
